label: ETV6::PDGFRB

sections.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
PDGFRB encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor beta, a receptor tyrosine kinase.

The fusion couples ETV6 oligomerization to the PDGFRB kinase, driving ligand-independent signaling. It occurs in myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms that often show eosinophilia or a chronic myelomonocytic presentation.
Imatinib has produced durable long-term remissions in PDGFRB-fusion-positive myeloid neoplasms, including ETV6::PDGFRB disease.
